headlines.title: Maine Democrats select Troy Jackson as Senate candidate
headlines.description: Former state senator Troy Jackson will now take on longtime Republican Senator Susan Collins after Graham Platner’s campaign in scandal. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands race to escape wildfires in France and Spain
headlines.description: An urgent effort to contain multiple massive wildfires. French officials changed the course of the final stage of the famed "Tour de France" race amid the ongoing disaster. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Influencer killed by husband after she accused him of pedophilia on TikTok
headlines.description: Social media influencer Sara Gilson was killed by her estranged husband less than two weeks after she posted on TikTok accusing him of pedophilia, according to police and court records.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia trades fire with Iran-backed rebels in Yemen
headlines.description: There were no new strikes against Iran overnight. The pause comes as there appears to be a new warfront opening in the Middle East, with Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi rebels trading fire. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports from Jerusalem.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: ‘Cockroaches won’: India’s youth protest leaders declare victory as minister resigns
headlines.description: India’s viral Cockroach Janta Party called off its nationwide protests on Saturday after the country’s education minister resigned and the government agreed to a number of the activist movement’s demands.
